endButton: Give GISEI Power Token to Sawtelle Spirit

dialogues.speaker: player
dialogues.text: YOU: This must be the Tensho Drug Store, right Sachi?.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: SACHI: Yes, everyone in the neighborhood comes here for medicine and news.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: JOHN TOSHIYUKI: Sachi, good to see you!

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: I've got your family's medicine and your father's newspaper.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Toshiyuki! You always go out of your way for us.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Mr. Toshiyuki, what is that token in your window?

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: That's the symbol for GISEI. It means sacrifice.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Sometimes it means giving up your time, comfort, or health so others can thrive.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: I work long hours, but it's worth it to help my family and the neighborhood.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: I can see how you sacrificed a lot for your daughter and the community.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Thank you for teaching us about GISEI!

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: May it remind you that GISEI (Sacrifice) helps to keep our community strong.
